title: First Meta model call: SAM 3.1
text: SAM 3.1 outlines obstacles in 10 park photos. The very first Meta model we ran.

title: Kimodo job on Modal
text: A cloud GPU job (one L4) writes new moves from text when the mocap library has none.

title: First moves, checked for realism
text: Starter move clips only play if they pass a plausibility check, so every motion on screen looks real.

title: First video becomes motion
text: SAM 3D Body reads a person in video into 30 joints. The cloud GPU job runs on Modal.

title: Video to motion pipeline
text: A filmed move becomes a 30-joint skeleton clip. Faces are masked before anything is measured.

title: Gate refuses bad video motion
text: Four stock clips went through. Two failed the physics check, so they never reached the game.

title: Faces masked before anything else
text: Before the computer reads a video of a person, it hides every face first.

title: Video to motion on Modal
text: A Modal app masks faces, then SAM 3D Body reads a body from each frame.

title: Simulator ticks at 120 Hz
text: The game world moves in fixed 1/120 s steps. Each law is tested against its closed form.

title: The simulator is born
text: The simulator is the game's physics engine. It runs on a fixed 1/120 s clock.

title: The Dojo opens
text: The Dojo has experiments from the simulator: turn the knobs, guess, then run.

title: First photo becomes a 3D object
text: SAM 3 cuts the object out of a photo. SAM 3D Objects lifts it into 3D, on Modal.

title: Photo becomes a 3D object
text: One park photo is cut out and lifted into a solid 3D shape. It lands in the editor at real size.

title: Photo masks use SAM 3
text: Photos get a privacy mask first. Then SAM 3 cuts out the object we want.

title: Photo to object on Modal
text: A photo is cut out by SAM 3 on an L4, then SAM 3D Objects lifts it to 3D on an L40S.

title: Pick a place on a map
text: Choose a spot on a real map. Its buildings become a course piece.

title: Trampoline cue flashed too early
text: The hint popped up before the rope was behind you. Now it waits until the rope is passed.

title: World Editor opens
text: Place pieces on a plan view, scale them to real size, turn and move them.

title: Domes threw jumpers back
text: A jump from the rising side snapped to the platform edge. Fixed, with tests.

title: Photo objects join the editor
text: Objects lifted from real photos drop in at real size. The best lane is measured to match.

title: First Muse Spark Open helper
text: A course-design partner suggests pieces for your world. It runs on Baseten.

title: Design partner on Baseten
text: An open AI model suggests course ideas. The simulator still checks every suggestion.

title: Muse Spark Open on Baseten
text: The course-design partner calls Muse Spark Open through Baseten. The key stays on the server.

title: World Slicer: first cut
text: The World Slicer cuts a real place at one height and shows the lane at that height.

title: Pose-conditioned Kimodo on Modal
text: Hand-set key poses go to Kimodo on Modal, and the gate checks what comes back.

title: Simulator proves a course
text: Shift+I runs one ideal run through every obstacle. If the simulator can clear it, the course is fair.

title: No teleport in the vault
text: The vault now moves smoothly every tick. 36 test cases watch for jumps.

title: 40 editor buttons became 8
text: One top bar, one Add piece menu, one More menu. The editor stopped feeling crowded.

title: Courses screen gets pictures
text: The Courses screen shows a picture card for every world.

title: Early roll presses ignored
text: Pressing X too soon used to count. Now only the last 0.15 s before landing does.

title: Street photos only if people-free
text: Live street photos show only when the check finds nobody in them.

title: Ghost replays the ideal run
text: A see-through runner repeats the best run on the same clock. A gap in words shows how far behind you are.

title: Captured vault and climb ship
text: Two real filmed moves pass the gate and play in the game. Run, leap and hang come from motion-capture files.

title: Unsafe photos are rejected
text: If hiding people fails, the photo is thrown out. Masked copies are never stored.

title: Labs: the first Lab page
text: Labs let you try the ideas yourself. Lab 1 is Search, with the simulator as the test bed.

title: Muse Wonder reviews the simulator
text: It checked 21 claims about our physics. 13 were real, 2 were fixed.

title: Muse Wonder reviews the simulator
text: It made 21 claims. 13 were real bugs, 7 false alarms, 1 unclear. Two fixed at once.

title: MusicGen writes the first music
text: Five original loops, one for each screen. Made from text prompts.

title: Music loops from MusicGen
text: Five original loops, one per screen, were made by MusicGen on a Modal GPU.

title: Muse Spark Open checks uploads
text: Baseten answers ok, review or block for each uploaded photo. Errors count as review.

title: Dojo gets a new look
text: Warm light theme, four steps and one graph. Press T to open the course picker.

title: Server replays your run
text: The simulator runs again on the server to check a run. Real clears are far under its time limit.

title: Course music loops smoothly
text: MusicGen music cut to 5 whole bars at 140 bpm. The tail fades into the start.

title: Simulator trial counts fixed
text: The ideal-run search now counts the run-in to the bars, so the simulator tries the right plans.

title: Forks get an ideal run each
text: A course can split into two routes. The search proves a best run for both.

title: Photo to 3D object, for everyone
text: Players can turn a photo into a piece online. With limits and a safety check.

title: Player photos reach Modal
text: Submit and status routes send a photo to the Modal lift, with limits and a safety check first.

title: Skip leak closed on lanes
text: A platform could be used without standing on its gate. Now it is solid only after that.

title: Upload service crash loop fixed
text: A setting that sometimes existed made the live upload service crash again and again. It is now always set.

title: Live upload checked on preview
text: A real photo went through a real Modal lift and was placed with its credit.

title: A robot checks for personal details
text: A test hunts for emails, home folders and addresses before anything is shared.

title: Privacy check also reads pictures
text: It now looks inside pictures for GPS spots and serial numbers, and in commit messages.

title: Leaderboard of verified runs
text: Players get a tag and a personal best. Only checked runs are listed.

title: Players keyed by a one-way code
text: The server keeps a scrambled code, not your address.

title: World stats on the picker
text: The course picker shows players and runs in the last 24 hours.

title: Rope: hold E to stay on
text: Catching and releasing a rope now follows the key. The ideal run and all golden traces were rebuilt.

title: On the board only if you click
text: A run is public only when you press Publish. Unpublished runs keep no name.

title: Community is one flow
text: The Community screen gets tabs, then one stepper: Photo, Mark, Segment, Choose, Make.

title: Home screen: the welcome park
text: The Home screen opens on a 3D park, two Rookies and four doors into the game.

title: First Muse Image character
text: Muse Image draws a character that becomes playable. Eight were tried.

title: Modal jobs report real stages
text: The progress bar follows the real GPU stages. Limit refusals say how long to wait.

title: Leaderboard opens
text: One shared list, top 100, Chase Ghost on every row. Shown on the four listed courses.

title: Fast cart no longer flies off
text: Tall coasters now end in a dead flat run-out, so there is no bump to fly off.

title: Person-for-scale was off its ring
text: A clone kept the old bones, so the figure sat away from its ring. Redrawn right.

title: Every AI call written down
text: One page lists the prompt, input, output and model of each call, plus Baseten cold-start timing.

title: Voice badges say who talks
text: Every helper wears a badge: Simulator, Course Agent, Cutter and more. You always know who is speaking.

title: A character learns the course
text: Lab 12 lets a game character learn the trap course. It uses the same simulator as the game.

title: All 12 Labs get one bar
text: Every Lab by number and name, with Previous and Next. Labs are on by default.

title: Mapillary blur plus a size rule
text: We trust Mapillary's face blur and also drop photos with a big close-up person.

stat.caption: max person height, share of photo

title: Films recorded on Modal
text: One spec file per shot, recorded in real time on Modal machines.

title: Character maker names its models
text: The badge lists Muse Image, SAM 3.1 and SAM 3D Objects. Players see what built their character.

title: Slicer and Editor now agree
text: Every lane with a path matched in both tools, 844 of 844. Two stale tests fixed.

title: Shared links still show welcome
text: A link with a ref or analytics flag still opens the welcome screen.

title: One shared limit and access check
text: Server routes use one request limit and one access check, so no route is left out.

title: Stale test expectations updated
text: Tests still expected old answers after planned changes. Updated and golden hashes regenerated.

title: Whole world fingerprinted every tick
text: Every shipped course is checked tick by tick. A safety net for tidying the code.

title: Whole world fingerprinted
text: Every tick of every shipped course is hashed. Refactors cannot silently change the physics.

title: Every tick fingerprinted
text: A test hashes the whole world after every tick on every shipped course, as a safety net.

title: MIT code, licence for each asset
text: The code is MIT. Every picture, sound and model has its own licence.

title: The Making Of opens
text: A public section with the site map and the course map, both downloadable.

title: Fix it worker path was wrong
text: After the editor split, a path pointed one folder too high. A new test checks every such path.

title: SAM 3 mask back on an L4
text: The mask step runs on an L4 and scales down after 60 s to save GPU time.

title: Meet the crew
text: Ten animated character cards with names. A Make a character button sits beside them.

title: Same result on every machine
text: Node 22, Node 24 and workerd agree on every outcome. A test of the simulator.

title: Simulator: 7,525 runs agree
text: Different machines gave identical outcomes in 7,525 simulator runs.

title: Ideal run takes the bars
text: The search learned the first-rung hang, kip and release. It now clears monkey-bar courses.

title: SAM 3 does the privacy masking
text: The spec now says the privacy mask is SAM 3, running on a small cloud GPU.

title: Safety check results told honestly
text: The safety check flagged 37 of 38 bad cases. Child safety is listed as untested.

title: Pipelines table names Modal
text: The mask runs on an L4 and the 3D lift on an L40S.

title: Twelve real parkour parks, ready
text: Pick a real park by region and country. Each one is tied to a mapped area.

title: Monkey bars from a CC0 lift
text: A real photo gives the skin; measured rungs give the physics. A role-first clean-up measures only what is needed.

title: Person-checked street photos live
text: Street photos show live with credit and licence. We never copy them into the game.

title: Lab 16: the system design finale
text: Drag blocks into a flow and watch it work or fail. The last Lab.

title: Labs map no longer jumps
text: The reason panel has a fixed height, so hovering never moves the map.

title: Lab 19: determinism
text: A Lab shows why the same inputs give the same run. It joined the 22 Labs.

title: Code map snapshot refreshed
text: 383 communities can be opened one by one, and the README links the map.

title: Code map you can read
text: Edges are dimmer and keep their width while you zoom. Labels stay easy to read.
